English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #false Election Commissioner General addresses false claims regarding alleged release of postal vote results False Posts circulating on social media claiming to be the results of postal votes caught the attention of FactSeeker. by Anonymous | September 4, 2024 When inquired from Election Commissioner General Saman Sri Ratnayake, he told FactSeeker that postal vote counting will only commence once the general election has been conducted on September 21. He emphasised that these misleading posts are designed to deceive voters. Mr. Ratnayake added that strict legal action will be taken against creators of such posts. Accordingly, FactSeeker confirms that any claims regarding the release of postal vote results are false. Latest updates #misleading Did Sri Lankan MPs Receive a Rs. 60,000 Salary Increase? We are an independent fact-checking team affiliated with the Sri Lanka Press Institute(SLPI). The objective and long-term goal of the FactSeeker is to provide the public with reliable and verified content in the attempt of debunking mis/disinformation. The unit, with the SLPI, is committed to contributing to improved media literacy in Sri Lanka.
